explanation: Searched Mathlib for any statement about `idealOfVars` under `rename` or about `Ideal.map` of the span of `X '' s` (grep for `idealOfVars`, `rename`/`Ideal`/`span` combinations in `Mathlib/Algebra/MvPolynomial` and `Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPolynomial`). Mathlib only has `MvPolynomial.idealOfVars` (defined as `.span (.range X)`) together with results like `idealOfVars_fg`, `idealOfVars_eq_restrictSupportIdeal`, `pow_idealOfVars`, `mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff'` and `mem_ideal_span_X_image`; none of them describes the image of `idealOfVars` under `rename`. The library's proof just combines the general `Ideal.map_span`, `Set.range_comp` and `rename_X` (a funext pointwise computation), so no single Mathlib declaration states this result and it is not a one- or two-line instantiation of an existing one.
